title: 第5章 飞花摘叶皆可为剑第6章 武极宗会武登武极殿
content_zh:
第5章飞花摘叶，皆可为剑！
武极宗。
内宗院落。
林尘赶回来修炼。
院落之中，汇聚着浓郁的天地灵气。
林尘盘坐在蒲团上，开启武魂，吸纳天地灵气入体。
半个时辰后，林尘体内灵力激荡，突破到聚灵八重境！
林尘吐出一口浊气，灵力运转周天，收功。
然后，取出御风剑诀，开始研究。
武道与剑道，两者都不能落下。
御风剑诀三式，林尘已经领悟透彻。
在灵剑宗的时候，林尘对各种剑法了然于胸，再修炼御风剑诀，效率极高。
林尘暂时不想暴露自己的武魂，若是让人发现林尘新觉醒了至尊神龙武魂，恐怕会惹来灾祸。
所以，林尘现在修炼剑道，武魂作为底牌。
房间之中，林尘挥剑，速度极快，斩出三道剑影，隐隐间，甚至有一缕剑气诞生！
御风剑诀，已经接近大成。
“御风剑诀，剑随风而动，风起，万物皆可为剑，不必拘泥于固定剑招。”
林尘心道。
雪儿在房间打扫卫生，看到林尘练剑，美眸瞪得滚圆，呆若木鸡。
“林公子刚拿到御风剑诀秘籍还没多久，就能斩出三道剑影，好可怕！”

雪儿酥胸起伏，心中惊讶不已，据她所知，御风剑诀修炼到巅峰，可一剑斩出五道剑影，快如疾风。
林尘挥剑，不再施展固定剑招，而是随心所欲，剑光交织成一片网络，如水银泻地！
房间之中，清风拂动，发出阵阵清脆的剑鸣之声，仿若龙吟！
突然，门外传来一阵杂乱的脚步声。
林尘脸色变得阴沉。
“轰！”
房屋大门，再次被一脚踹开。
一位劲装男子，站在门口，满脸挑衅。
“公子，他是真传弟子王珉，皇甫逸的心腹之人，实力很强，恐怕来者不善。”
雪儿神色紧张。
王珉在真传弟子当中也属于强者！
王珉身后，还有三人，其中一人正是赵拓！
另外两人是内宗天才，抬着赵拓过来。
腿断了，抬也要给他抬过来。
赵拓被林尘打断了双腿，恨意滔天，反正有王珉坐镇，他要来看林尘被暴打！
content_en:
Chapter 5 Flying flowers and picking leaves can all be used as swords!
Wu Jizong.
Inner sect courtyard.
Lin Chen rushed back to practice.
In the courtyard, there is a strong aura of heaven and earth.
Lin Chen sat cross-legged on the futon, activated his martial soul, and absorbed the spiritual energy of heaven and earth into his body.
Half an hour later, the spiritual power in Lin Chen's body surged and he broke through to the eighth level of spirit gathering!
Lin Chen exhaled a breath of turbid air, and his spiritual power circulated around the sky, finishing his work.
Then, he took out the Wind Control Sword Art and began to study it.
Martial arts and swordsmanship, neither can fall behind.
Lin Chen has thoroughly understood the three styles of the Wind Control Sword Technique.
When he was in the Lingjian Sect, Lin Chen had a thorough understanding of various sword techniques, and then practiced the Wind Control Sword Technique with great efficiency.
Lin Chen didn't want to expose his martial spirit for the time being. If anyone found out that Lin Chen had newly awakened the Supreme Dragon Spirit, it would probably cause disaster.
Therefore, Lin Chen now practices swordsmanship, using Wuhun as his trump card.
In the room, Lin Chen swung his sword very fast, slashing out three sword shadows, and faintly, a wisp of sword energy was even born!
The Wind Control Sword Technique is close to completion.
"Wind Control Sword Technique, the sword moves with the wind. When the wind blows, everything can be used as a sword. There is no need to stick to fixed sword moves."
Lin Chen thought.
Xue'er was cleaning the room and saw Lin Chen practicing his sword. Her beautiful eyes widened and she was dumbfounded.
"Not long after Mr. Lin got the secret book of the Wind Control Sword Technique, he was able to slash out three sword shadows. How terrifying!"
Xue'er's chest rose and fell, and she was filled with surprise. According to her knowledge, after practicing the Wind Control Sword Technique to its peak, one could cut five sword shadows with one sword, as fast as the wind.
Lin Chen swung his sword, no longer using fixed sword moves, but doing whatever he wanted. The sword light intertwined into a network, like mercury pouring down the ground!
In the room, the breeze blew, and there were crisp sounds of swords, like dragon roars!
Suddenly, there was a burst of chaotic footsteps outside the door.
Lin Chen's expression turned gloomy.
"Boom!"
The door to the house was kicked open again.
A well-dressed man stood at the door with a provocative face.
"Young master, he is Wang Min, the true disciple, Huangfu Yi's confidant. He is very powerful. I'm afraid the person who comes here is not good."
Xueer looked nervous.
Wang Min is also a strong one among the true disciples!
Behind Wang Min, there were three other people, one of whom was Zhao Tuo!
The other two were geniuses from the inner sect and carried Zhao Tuo over.
Even if his leg is broken, he has to carry it over.
Zhao Tuo had his legs broken by Lin Chen, and his hatred was overwhelming. Wang Min was here anyway, and he wanted to see Lin Chen being beaten!
